parameters.name: NodeType
parameters.description:
The type of nodes to query. Valid values:
- all: queries both dn and gms nodes.
- gms: queries only gms nodes.
- dn: queries only dn nodes.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be a positive integer that does not exceed the maximum value of the integer data type. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region in which the instance resides.
